# Operator reference

Arity is the number of stack items an operator consumes: a number, `variadic` (whole stack) or `varies` (depends on the stack or blocks).

| Operator | Arity | Description |
|----------|-------|-------------|
| `noop` | 0 | Do nothing. |
| `∅` | 0 | Do nothing (alias of noop). |
| `clear` | variadic | Remove every item from the stack. |
| `...` | 1 | Spread an array onto the stack as individual items. |
| `spread` | 1 | Spread an array onto the stack as individual items (alias of ...). |
| `drop` | 1 | Remove the top item. |
| `keepN` | 1 | Keep only the bottom N items, dropping the rest. Written keepN(N); N is taken from the stack. |
| `retrieve` | 1 | Replace the stack with the single item I positions below the top (0 = top). Written retrieve(I). |
| `dig` | 1 | Pull the Nth item from the top up to the top. Written dig(N). |
| `bury` | 1 | Move the top item N positions down. Written bury(N). |
| `dupe` | 1 | Duplicate the top item. |
| `dup` | 1 | Duplicate the top item (alias of dupe). |
| `copy` | variadic | Duplicate the entire stack. |
| `swap` | 2 | Swap the top two items. |
| `reverse` | variadic | Reverse the whole stack. |
| `count` | 0 | Push the current stack depth. |
| `depth` | 0 | Push the current stack depth (alias of count). |
| `collect` | variadic | Collect every stack item into a single array. |
| `peek` | 1 | Print the top item to the console without consuming it. |
| `peek-all` | variadic | Print every stack item to the console without consuming them. |
| `apply` | varies | Pop a block and execute it against the stack. |
| `exec` | varies | Pop a block and execute it against the stack (alias of apply). |
| `over` | 2 | Copy the second item to the top. |
| `rot` | 3 | Rotate the third item to the top. |
| `+` | 2 | Add two numbers. |
| `-` | 2 | Subtract the top number from the one below it. |
| `*` | 2 | Multiply two numbers. |
| `⋅` | 2 | Multiply two numbers (alias of *). |
| `/` | 2 | Divide the lower number by the top number. |
| `÷` | 2 | Divide the lower number by the top number (alias of /). |
| `**` | 2 | Raise the lower number to the power of the top number. |
| `%` | 2 | Modulo (result takes the sign of the divisor). |
| `%%` | 2 | Remainder (result takes the sign of the dividend). |
| `++` | 1 | Increment by one. |
| `--` | 1 | Decrement by one. |
| `Σ` | variadic | Sum every stack item. |
| `Π` | variadic | Multiply every stack item together. |
| `abs` | 1 | Absolute value. |
| `\|𝑥\|` | 1 | Absolute value (alias of abs). |
| `√` | 1 | Square root (alias of sqrt). |
| `sqrt` | 1 | Square root. |
| `floor` | 1 | Round down to an integer. |
| `ceil` | 1 | Round up to an integer. |
| `round` | 1 | Round to the nearest integer. |
| `trunc` | 1 | Drop the fractional part. |
| `log` | 1 | Natural logarithm. |
| `min` | variadic | Smallest of every stack item. |
| `max` | variadic | Largest of every stack item. |
| `plus` | 2 | Add two numbers (alias of +). |
| `minus` | 2 | Subtract the top number from the one below it (alias of -). |
| `mul` | 2 | Multiply two numbers (alias of *). |
| `div` | 2 | Divide the lower number by the top number (alias of /). |
| `mod` | 2 | Modulo (alias of %). |
| `pow` | 2 | Exponentiation (alias of **). |
| `=` | 2 | Strict equality. |
| `==` | 2 | Loose equality. |
| `<` | 2 | True if the lower item is less than the top item. |
| `<=` | 2 | True if the lower item is less than or equal to the top item. |
| `>` | 2 | True if the lower item is greater than the top item. |
| `>=` | 2 | True if the lower item is greater than or equal to the top item. |
| `<=>` | 2 | Three-way comparison: -1, 0 or 1. |
| `eq?` | 2 | Strict equality (alias of =). |
| `ne?` | 2 | Not equal (alias of !=). |
| `!=` | 2 | Not equal. |
| `lt?` | 2 | Less than (alias of <). |
| `le?` | 2 | Less than or equal (alias of <=). |
| `gt?` | 2 | Greater than (alias of >). |
| `ge?` | 2 | Greater than or equal (alias of >=). |
| `&&` | 2 | Logical AND. |
| `\|\|` | 2 | Logical OR. |
| `xor` | 2 | Exclusive OR. |
| `nand` | 2 | Logical NOT AND. |
| `nor` | 2 | Logical NOT OR. |
| `~~` | 1 | Logical NOT. |
| `not` | 1 | Logical NOT (alias of ~~). |
| `if` | varies | Conditional: run a block when the condition is truthy (optionally with an else block). |
| `elseif` | varies | Chain another conditional onto a preceding if. |
| `else` | varies | Default branch of a conditional chain. |
| `when` | 2 | Pop a condition; keep the value below it only if the condition is truthy. |
| `drop-when` | 2 | Pop a condition; drop the value below it if the condition is truthy. |
| `keep-if` | 2 | Keep the value if the condition is truthy. |
| `drop-if` | 2 | Drop the value if the condition is truthy. |
| `times` | varies | Run a block N times. |
| `while` | varies | Run a body block while a condition block yields truthy. |
| `until` | varies | Run a body block until a condition block yields truthy. |
| `break` | 0 | Exit the current loop. |
| `try` | varies | Run a block; on error push the Error instead of propagating. |
| `throw` | 1 | Throw the top item as an error. |
| `error?` | 1 | True if the top item is an Error. |
| `len` | 1 | Length of a string or array. |
| `upper` | 1 | Uppercase a string. |
| `lower` | 1 | Lowercase a string. |
| `trim` | 1 | Trim surrounding whitespace. |
| `strcat` | 2 | Concatenate two strings. |
| `strseq` | 2 | Concatenate two strings in reverse order. |
| `startsWith` | 2 | True if the string starts with the given prefix. |
| `endsWith` | 2 | True if the string ends with the given suffix. |
| `indexOf` | 2 | Index of a substring (or -1). |
| `starts?` | 2 | True if the string starts with the given prefix (alias of startsWith). |
| `ends?` | 2 | True if the string ends with the given suffix (alias of endsWith). |
| `index-of` | 2 | Index of a substring (alias of indexOf). |
| `typeof` | 1 | Push the type name of the top item. |
| `number?` | 1 | True if the top item is a number. |
| `string?` | 1 | True if the top item is a string. |
| `array?` | 1 | True if the top item is an array. |
| `nil?` | 1 | True if the top item is null or undefined. |
| `function?` | 1 | True if the top item is a function or block. |
| `empty?` | 1 | True if the string or array is empty. |
| `contains?` | 2 | True if the array or string contains the element. |
| `into-json` | 1 | Stringify a value to JSON. |
| `from-json` | 1 | Parse a JSON string. |
| `into-lines` | 1 | Join an array of strings with newlines. |
| `from-lines` | 1 | Split a string on newlines into an array. |
| `to-json` | 1 | Parse a JSON string (legacy alias of from-json). |
| `to-lines` | 1 | Split a string on newlines (legacy alias of from-lines). |
| `push` | 2 | Append an item to an array. |
| `pop` | 1 | Remove the last element of an array; push the array and the element. |
| `shift` | 1 | Remove the first element of an array; push the array and the element. |
| `unshift` | 2 | Prepend an item to an array. |
| `suppose` | 2 | Add an item to an array or Set. |
| `flatten` | variadic | Flatten nested arrays among all stack items into a flat sequence of items. |
| `map` | varies | Apply a block to each element of an array, collecting the results. |
| `filter` | varies | Keep the elements of an array for which a block yields truthy. |
| `reduce` | varies | Fold an array with a block and an initial value. |
| `fold` | varies | Fold an array with a block and an initial value (alias of reduce). |
| `bend` | varies | Unfold an array from a seed, a predicate block and a step block. |
| `keys` | 1 | Keys of an object. |
| `values` | 1 | Values of an object. |
| `entries` | 1 | [key, value] pairs of an object. |
| `merge` | 2 | Merge two objects. |
| `record` | variadic | Build an object from stack items taken as value/key pairs. |
| `each` | varies | Apply a block to each stack item. |
| `fanout` | varies | Run a value through several blocks, pushing every result. |
| `zip` | 2 | Pair up the elements of two arrays. |
| `compose` | 2 | Combine two blocks into one pipeline block. |
| `_` | 1 | Await the promise on top of the stack and push its resolved value. |
| `__` | variadic | Await every promise on the stack (Promise.all). |
| `$` | varies | Execute a block (legacy alias of apply). |
| `$$` | varies | Execute a block and spread its result. |
| `<<-` | varies | Rewind: move every stack item back into the processing queue. |
| `->>` | varies | Skip: push every remaining queue item as a value instead of running it. |
| `next` | 1 | Advance an iterator and push its next value. |
| `iter` | 1 | Create an iterator from an iterable. |
| `..` | 1 | Exhaust an iterator into an array. |
| `fibonacci` | 2 | Fibonacci step: given a b, push b a a+b. |
| `x̄` | variadic | Arithmetic mean of the stack (alias of mean). |
| `mean` | variadic | Arithmetic mean of every stack item. |
| `median` | variadic | Median of every stack item. |
| `mode` | variadic | Most frequent stack item. |
| `modes` | variadic | Array of all most-frequent stack items. |

## Dynamic operators

| Syntax | Arity | Description |
|--------|-------|-------------|
| `N+  N-  N*  N/  N%  N**` | 1 | Number-prefixed arithmetic: `N op x` applies the operator with N as the left operand (3+ adds 3). Suffix n for BigInt (3n+). |
| `Nlog` | 1 | Logarithm of x in base N (10log). |
| `***  ****  ...` | 2 | Hyperoperations: *** is tetration, **** pentation, and so on. |
